title: Two Storages, One Interface
prompt: Implement MemoryStorage (dict-backed) and class PrefixedStorage wrapping another storage and adding 'p:' to every key on save and load (delegation + composition). Both satisfy the Storage protocol from the lesson.

tests.name: memory storage round-trips
tests.code:
m = MemoryStorage()
m.save('k', 'v')
assert m.load('k') == 'v'
assert m.load('nope') is None
tests.hint: dict-backed save/load; missing key loads None.

tests.name: prefixed storage delegates
tests.code:
m = MemoryStorage()
p = PrefixedStorage(m)
p.save('k', 'v')
assert m.load('p:k') == 'v'
assert p.load('k') == 'v'
tests.hint: Prefixed adds 'p:' on the way in and reads through with the prefix.
